reason: This plugin is primarily an automation utility for Git workflow management in DeepSeek Harness sessions: it captures and displays repository context, offers `/git` commands and an agent tool for branch/worktree/merge/stash actions, and adds composer and sidebar UI to run those workflows with user confirmation and guardrails. Its focus is local project workflow control, not general development tooling, web browsing, or file-content transformation.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供 Git 工作流自动化能力，展示仓库上下文并通过命令与界面支持分支、工作树、暂存和合并等操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds Git workflow automation to DeepSeek Harness sessions by showing repo context and exposing branch, worktree, stash, and merge operations through commands and UI controls.

capabilities: Captures repository git context (branch, status, stashes, commits, worktrees) and injects it into sessions.
Executes local git workflow actions via `/git` commands and an agent tool, including branch and worktree operations.
Provides interactive UI controls in the web composer/sidebar for branch/worktree actions and stash handling.
Can perform merge and cleanup actions, including optional branch/worktree removal steps with guardrails.

reasons.code: README documents session git context capture and `/git` commands for branch switch, branch create, stash, log, worktree add/remove, and merge operations.
README states the plugin can switch branches, create and remove worktrees, and remove branches after merge based on user choice, so local repository state may change.
README describes dirty-tree guards and force options for potentially destructive actions, indicating explicit user-facing control and mitigation.
